items.question: Where is Congo located according to the letter?
What education-related work does Ashar Santoso do in Congo?
items.modelAnswer: He takes care of children’s education in a community school as a member of a voluntary organisation.

items.question: How did Ashar’s schooling involve different countries?
items.modelAnswer: He was born in Indonesia, moved to Singapore at eight and later completed schooling in Denmark before university studies in the United States.

items.question: Why is Ashar called a global citizen?
items.modelAnswer: He has lived, studied and worked in different countries and values understanding people’s languages, cultures and aspirations. His outlook connects him with humanity beyond one country.
